CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .

2. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   C. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   D. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   B. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   D. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   B. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   C. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   D. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   D. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   C. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 4.4 Marriage and Family 4.5 Christian Response to Modern Medicin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Marriage and Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Response to Modern Medicine, Science and Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
